title: In-memory embedding retriever with cached vectors
description:
## Purpose

Provide the simplest semantic retriever: an in-memory index of normalized embedding vectors with exact cosine search.

## Scope

- In-memory `VectorStore` (default `store.kind: memory`), exact cosine; numpy only as an optional extra.
- Embedding providers as optional extras: `openai` (`text-embedding-3-small`, 512 dims, for the experiment), `local-onnx`, and a `fake` hashing embedder for specs.
- Vector cache keyed by (provider, model, dimensions, normalized-text SHA-256); fingerprint includes model and revision. Embedding only in an explicit opt-in step; never on import or in specs.
- Owner question Q5 (embedding default for customer data: API egress vs local ONNX) stays open; do not pick a customer default here. Phase 3.

## Definition of done

Specs first with the `fake` embedder and no network: exact top-k by cosine, label filter, target exclusion, cache hit on re-run, fingerprint changes with model/dims. `make test` green. Cost: $0 in core.

## Acceptance scenario

```gherkin
Feature: In-memory embedding retriever with cached vectors
  Scenario: Exact nearest neighbours per label without the target
    Given a labeled pool embedded with the fake embedder
    When the target asks for the top 4 items of each label
    Then the results are the exact cosine neighbours, exclude the target, and break ties by ID
  Scenario: Cached vectors are reused
    Given a vector cache written by an earlier run
    When the same pool is indexed again
    Then no embedding call is made
```

## Design

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md) §4.4, Appendix B (embedding prices), Appendix C.

## Companion-project coordination

- [Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/tree/main/project/issues): `decision-flywheel-evaluations-e38febde-68aa-425a-be55-bd86cfb6f70c`.

These are cross-repository references; local Kanbus blocked-by relationships encode prerequisites within this repository.

comments.text:
Implemented on branch `phase3-retrieval` (worktree Decision-Flywheel-phase3), commits 0b15981 and fed787d; not merged or pushed. Offline only: specs use fake embedders, no network. `make test` equivalent: 289 passed (226 existing + 63 new).

- `EmbeddingRetriever(embed, embedder_identity, cache=None, new_store=InMemoryVectorStore, batch_size=256)` and `EmbeddingRetriever.from_embedder(embedder)`.
- `VectorCache(path)`: append-only JSONL of {embedder, text_sha256, vector}; no text. Keyed by embedder identity (provider:model:dims) and SHA-256 of the embedded text (NFKC, whitespace collapsed, case kept).
- `InMemoryVectorStore`: exact cosine, numpy if installed (`[retrieval]` extra), pure Python otherwise; scores rounded to 9 decimals then ties by ID. Checked offline that numpy and pure-Python paths give identical rankings.
- `HashingEmbedder` fake for specs; `OpenAIEmbedder` reference (text-embedding-3-small, 512 dims) is lazy: no import or call until `OpenAIEmbedder.from_environment()`, which loads .env via python-dotenv if installed (`[openai-embeddings]` extra). Never called in specs; request shape checked with a fake client.
- Q5 (customer-data default: API vs local ONNX) left open; no local-onnx provider built.
